ValidationRule.description: In case ERE & Mini Tail exists
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT(ISPICKVAL(File_Type__c, "Memo") ) && !ISNULL( Report_Date__c ) && !ISNULL(Policy__r.ERE_Date__c) && !ISNULL(Policy__r.Mini_Tail_Override_Date__c) && Report_Date__c > Policy__r.ERE_Date__c && Report_Date__c > Policy__r.Mini_Tail_Override_Date__c
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Report Date should not be greater than related Policy's 'ERE' Date' or Policy's 'Mini Tail Date'!
